fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Female Health Worker DV Document Upload 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the DV Document Upload for the Female Health Worker (ANM) Post. This recruitment was released for 5272 posts. The applications for UPSSSC Female Health Worker (ANM) Recruitment 2024 were accepted from October 28, 2024, to November 27, 2024. The written examination is scheduled to be conducted on January 11, 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSSSC Female Health Worker (ANM) DV Document Upload 2026 from the link provided below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 14 October 2024
  • Application Start Date : 28 October 2024
  • Last Date : 27 November 2024
  • Last Date of Fee Payment : 27 November 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 04 December 2024
  • Exam Date : 11 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 01 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 07 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 April 2026
  • Result : 24 August 2026
  • DV Document Upload : 27 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
